objectives.en: Test the equality of two proportions using the pooled estimate

narration.en: A coin gives 216 heads in 400 tosses. A survey finds more smokers in one city than another. Claims about percentages are tested with the large-sample test for proportions.
narration.kn: ಒಂದು ನಾಣ್ಯ 400 ಚಿಮ್ಮುವಿಕೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 216 ತಲೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಒಂದು ನಗರದಲ್ಲಿ ಇನ್ನೊಂದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಧೂಮಪಾನಿಗಳು. ಶೇಕಡಾವಾರು ಹೇಳಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಅನುಪಾತಗಳ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಮಾದರಿ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯಿಂದ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ.

body.en: To test $H_0: P = P_0$ using a large sample with proportion $p = x/n$: $Z = \dfrac{p - P_0}{\sqrt{P_0 Q_0 / n}}$, $Q_0 = 1 - P_0$. Equivalently, in terms of the number of successes, $Z = \dfrac{x - nP_0}{\sqrt{nP_0Q_0}}$.
body.kn: H₀: P = P₀ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಲು Z = (p − P₀)/√(P₀Q₀/n). ಯಶಸ್ಸುಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ Z = (x − nP₀)/√(nP₀Q₀).

points.en: Same Z for proportion or count

narration.en: To test H_0: P = P_0 using a large sample with proportion p = x/n: Z = dfracp - P_0rootP_0 Q_0 / n, Q_0 = 1 - P_0. Equivalently, in terms of the number of successes, Z = dfracx - nP_0rootnP_0Q_0.
narration.kn: H₀: P = P₀ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಲು Z = (p − P₀)/√(P₀Q₀/n). ಯಶಸ್ಸುಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ Z = (x − nP₀)/√(nP₀Q₀).

narration.en: The teacher tests a coin that gave 216 heads in 400 tosses, step by step.

say.en: 400 tosses, 216 heads. Under H nought the coin is fair, so P is one half.
Standard error uses P nought: root of 0.5 times 0.5 over 400, which is 0.025.
Z equals 0.54 minus 0.5 over 0.025, which is 1.6.
1.6 is less than 1.96, so it falls in the acceptance region. The coin may be regarded as fair.

body.en: To test $H_0: P_1 = P_2$ from two large samples, pool them: $\hat{p} = \dfrac{n_1p_1 + n_2p_2}{n_1 + n_2} = \dfrac{x_1 + x_2}{n_1 + n_2}$, $\hat{q} = 1 - \hat{p}$. Then $Z = \dfrac{p_1 - p_2}{\sqrt{\hat{p}\hat{q}\,(1/n_1 + 1/n_2)}}$.
body.kn: H₀: P₁ = P₂ ಗೆ ಸಂಯೋಜಿತ ಅಂದಾಜು p̂ = (x₁ + x₂)/(n₁ + n₂). Z = (p₁ − p₂)/√(p̂q̂(1/n₁ + 1/n₂)).

narration.en: To test H_0: P_1 = P_2 from two large samples, pool them: hatp = dfracn_1p_1 + n_2p_2n_1 + n_2 = dfracx_1 + x_2n_1 + n_2, hatq = 1 - hatp. Then Z = dfracp_1 - p_2roothatphatq,(1/n_1 + 1/n_2).
narration.kn: H₀: P₁ = P₂ ಗೆ ಸಂಯೋಜಿತ ಅಂದಾಜು p̂ = (x₁ + x₂)/(n₁ + n₂). Z = (p₁ − p₂)/√(p̂q̂(1/n₁ + 1/n₂)).

narration.en: Change the count of successes and the sample size. With the same sample proportion, a bigger sample gives a bigger Z.

problem.en: In a sample of 600 men from city A, 450 are smokers; in 900 men from city B, 450 are smokers. Test at 1% whether the proportions of smokers differ.

heading.en: Which P goes in the SE?

body.en: In a test, the SE always uses the value under H₀: P₀ for one proportion, the pooled p̂ for two. The sample p goes only in the numerator.

narration.en: Recap. One proportion: Z = (p − P₀)/√(P₀Q₀/n). Count form: Z = (x − nP₀)/√(nP₀Q₀). Two proportions: pooled p̂ = (x₁ + x₂)/(n₁ + n₂). Z = (p₁ − p₂)/√(p̂q̂(1/n₁ + 1/n₂)).
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಒಂದು ಅನುಪಾತ: Z = (p − P₀)/√(P₀Q₀/n). ಎಣಿಕೆ ರೂಪ: Z = (x − nP₀)/√(nP₀Q₀). ಎರಡು ಅನುಪಾತ: p̂ = (x₁ + x₂)/(n₁ + n₂). Z = (p₁ − p₂)/√(p̂q̂(1/n₁ + 1/n₂)).
